_comment: Copy to runner.config.json. Unknown keys such as _comment are ignored. Relative paths resolve against this file's directory. See packages/runner/README.md.

slots._comment_allowed_tools: Per-repo allowlist is an OPEN item (design §6): keep it config-driven. The three bridge-bus worker tools are always added by the runner. The mcp__jira__* / mcp__gitlab__* names are placeholders: use the tool names exposed by the MCP servers listed in mcp_config_files.
slots._comment_mcp_config_files: Extra MCP servers for this repo (Jira, GitLab). Required because the worker runs with --strict-mcp-config.
